definitions: A cavity within a bone or other tissue, especially one in the bones of the face or skull connecting with the nasal cavity.
A channel or cavity containing blood, especially venous blood.
A curved indentation or a bay.
A pocket or a recess in an organ or tissue.
examples: The patient complained of pain in their frontal sinus.
Blood samples were taken from the dural sinus.
The ship anchored in a small sinus of the coastline.
The surgeon examined the sinus of the kidney.
